baseline.engine: football/cfb_p4/engine.js (V1, shipped) replayed cold by football/cfb_p4/research/replay_rows.js
baseline.note: the replay passes no venue geometry, so V1’s home field is its 4.082-pt league constant and travel is 0 — exactly the shipped behaviour for the components that move the number

market.lines: consensus median across books; opening and closing as the archive labels them. No per-quote timestamps exist in the archive, so "closing" is the archive’s final number, not a verified kickoff-minute quote.
market.licence: a public archive this repository already uses; the underlying sportsbook data’s licence terms are not stated by the archive and were not independently verified

linear_gain.label: continuous: points per 1,000 ft of positive gain

piecewise.label: piecewise linear, knots at 1,000 and 3,000 ft

cat_3000.label: categorical: gain of 3,000 ft or more

buckets.label: categorical: 1,000-2,999 and 3,000+ ft (the research package specification)

cat_3000_acclim.label: 3,000+ ft, with a visitor that lives at altitude

cat_3000_recent.label: 3,000+ ft, with a visitor whose previous game was at altitude

cat_3000_pace.label: 3,000+ ft x V1’s pregame expected total (a scoring-pace proxy available live)

cat_3000_load.label: 3,000+ ft x visitor defence plays faced per game, season to date
cat_3000_load.why_ineligible: play counts exist only through 2021 in the research package, so no live pregame input exists to price it

cat_3000_opp_pace.label: 3,000+ ft x home offence plays per game, season to date (opponent pace)
cat_3000_opp_pace.why_ineligible: play counts exist only through 2021 in the research package, so no live pregame input exists to price it

cat_3000_travel.label: DIAGNOSTIC: 3,000+ ft with travel distance and time-zone change as controls
cat_3000_travel.why_ineligible: a diagnostic: it asks whether the altitude term survives travel controls; travel itself was rejected by V1’s validation and never prices

ratio6.label: DESCRIPTIVE: game elevation at least 6x the visitor’s normal elevation
ratio6.why_ineligible: the ratio is descriptive research only: a sea-level visitor reaches 6x at a 60 ft venue

placebo_descent.label: PLACEBO: visitor plays 1,000 ft or more BELOW normal
placebo_descent.why_ineligible: a placebo: altitude physiology predicts no visitor penalty for a descent

double_counting.reading: host_high is every non-neutral game at a 3,000+ ft venue, whoever visits: a positive value would mean V1 under-prices mountain home teams generally (double counting risk for any altitude term). With both terms, high_gain is identified only by visitors to the same mountain venues who live low against those who live high. The third fit asks whether that contrast survives travel distance and time-zone controls.

selection_rule: the eligible candidate with the largest pooled MAE improvement over ALL non-neutral games in the 2014-2021 walk-forward; 2022-2025 was not consulted

leave_one_out.venue: Sonny Lubick Field at Hughes Stadium

reasons: pooled MAE got worse by 0.019 points, against a 0.02 bar

support_text: Not established: in 13,511 FBS home games 2006–2025, home teams hosting a visitor that climbed 3,000+ ft beat EdgeDesk’s pregame number by +1.03 pts more than other home teams (95% CI −0.18 to +2.23; 651 games at 14 venues). Out of sample the adjustment did not pass its validation gates, so it moves 0 points.
